source_caption_text:
This video belongs in a museum 😭😂😂

Soulja Boy was giving lessons on how to talk trash on Xbox back in his vlog back in 2008 😭🎮

In this throwback clip, Soulja takes a break from music to show how he approached the other competition: talking on the headset. His confidence carried straight into gaming, turning a little Xbox banter into a comedy moment 😂

For anyone who grew up playing online during that era, the clip brings back memories of Xbox 360 lobbies, loud microphones and arguments that somehow continued long after the match ended. You could log on planning to play a few games and spend half the night going back and forth with somebody you’d never met 💀

It’s also a time capsule of the casual videos artists shared before livestreaming became such a big part of entertainment. A camera, a console and Soulja being himself were enough.

Who remembers watching Soulja Boy’s old YouTube videos? 😂🔥
